_README: YOUR WORKLIST. This file is empty on purpose — it is the shape, not the contents.
It holds the pieces of work that are open right now: what you are building, what is
blocked, what you decided to park. Each item has to say what would make it done, and
the machinery refuses an item that does not. That refusal is the point: a list of
things with no finish line is a list that only ever grows.
Do not edit this file by hand. Add items with machinery/_state.py — see FIRST-SESSION.md
at the top of the pack, which walks you through adding your first one.
Check it any time with:  python3 machinery/_state.py
